stemMd: Which assessment best matches the engineers’ view of the panels?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They helped, but did not by themselves solve the full listening problem.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They necessarily caused the ventilation noise.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They made all acoustic measurements useless.

explanationMd: The engineers acknowledge the specific improvement and the remaining user problem together. Their position avoids both total dismissal and premature success. The passage gives no evidence that the panels caused the other noise source.

distractorRationale.b: The passage does not establish that causal link.
